g.text: HD Map (14 channels) and Route (2 channels) rasters of one KITScenes Val v3.5 sample
450 x 300 cells at 0.4 m/px, X: -60 ... 120 m (up), Y: -60 ... 60 m (left positive to the left); red: ego and recorded 5 s trajectory
sample kitscenes-v1-93b7a937-b81a-c07e-0479-c84e8acbfd89-f000045 (route maneuver: straight, intersection ahead on route: False). Channels 7/8 store (sin+1)/2 and
(cos+1)/2 of the lane direction where channel 9 is 1; channel 11 stores (level+8)/16 where channel 12 is 1.
